courses.overview: 由任務剖面、加速模型與失效分析延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend mission profiles, acceleration models and failure analysis into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 電力電子散熱設計
related.why: 功率電子熱模型提供耐久的溫度任務剖面。
related.whyEn: Power-thermal models provide durability temperature profiles.
related.transfer: 功率電子熱模型提供耐久的溫度任務剖面。
related.transferEn: Power-thermal models provide durability temperature profiles.
related.difference: 穩態最高溫不等於循環疲勞，需要時間歷程。
related.differenceEn: Maximum steady temperature is not cyclic fatigue; time histories are needed.
practice: 把「任務剖面」的概念圖與「電力電子散熱設計」的輸入輸出對照。
比较相同最高温但不同幅度的剖面。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：穩態最高溫不等於循環疲勞，需要時間歷程。
practiceEn: Compare the mission profile concept map with inputs/outputs of Power-electronics thermal design.
Compare equal maxima with different temperature swings.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Maximum steady temperature is not cyclic fatigue; time histories are needed.

related.title: 選擇性焊接與回焊控制
related.why: 焊接材料和界面成為環境疲勞的重要起點。
related.whyEn: Solder materials/interfaces are starting points for environmental fatigue.
related.transfer: 焊接材料和界面成為環境疲勞的重要起點。
related.transferEn: Solder materials/interfaces are starting points for environmental fatigue.
related.difference: 製程合格與壽命驗證不同，需保留老化後證據。
related.differenceEn: Process acceptance differs from life validation and needs aged evidence.
practice: 把「元件與整機」的概念圖與「選擇性焊接與回焊控制」的輸入輸出對照。
分開比較有無偏壓下漏電和腐蝕形貌。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：製程合格與壽命驗證不同，需保留老化後證據。
practiceEn: Compare the component versus product concept map with inputs/outputs of Selective soldering and reflow control.
Compare leakage/corrosion with and without bias.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Process acceptance differs from life validation and needs aged evidence.

courses.summary: 汽車電子環境耐久驗證以任務剖面、加速模型與失效分析連結元件、系統和驗證。此定位提供公開供應鏈或工程案例的地理背景。
courses.summaryEn: Automotive-electronics environmental durability validation links components, systems and validation through mission profiles, acceleration models and failure analysis. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Renesas 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。通電時間、溫度分布與停機環境共同決定應力。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「任務剖面、加速模型與失效分析」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Renesas provides a traceable starting point. Powered time, temperature distribution and storage environment determine stress. Independently authored models connect this to mission profiles, acceleration models and failure analysis; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：過高應力可能引入使用中不存在的新機制。 以「比較加速前後破壞形貌確認機制一致。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Excess stress can introduce mechanisms absent in service. Practice interpretation using: Compare failure morphology to check mechanism consistency. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
